genre.zh: 南法小酒館美食雜誌（Bon Appétit 那種）
genre.en: a Provençal bistro feature in the manner of Bon Appétit: the real dining room, wine and bread on the table, late-afternoon sun

s: the plate on a linen-covered table on a terrace, hard late Provence-style sun from one side, a glass of white wine casting a long amber shadow
shot from directly overhead on a terracotta tablecloth: two hands with knife and fork poised over the plate, hard sun with crisp shadows

the box leans tall against a terracotta-orange kitchen tile backsplash, filling most of the frame, with a plated serving of the finished gnocchi in green pistou and seared sea bass sitting right beside it, hard morning sun from a window at the left throwing the box's sharp shadow across the tile and the countertop

the box stands upright on a worn oak dining table in a home kitchen against a deep sea-blue painted wall, large in the foreground, a steaming plate of the cooked gnocchi with pistou and golden sea bass pieces next to it and a fork resting on the rim, a single hard side light from a window on the right casting a long clean shadow of the box across the wood

the box sits on a mint-green tiled bathroom-style kitchen counter beside a cooked bowl of green pistou gnocchi topped with seared sea bass, a hard beam of afternoon sun from the upper left slicing across both and drawing crisp edges of shadow on the mint tile

the box is propped on a sunlit apartment balcony table against a tomato-red wall, huge in frame, the finished plate of pesto gnocchi with sea bass beside it and a glass of white wine, hard low sun from the right throwing the box's shadow and the plate's shadow long across the weathered table

the box rests on a butcher-block counter in a small home kitchen against a deep sea-blue tile wall, a pan of freshly cooked gnocchi and flaked sea bass in bright green pistou set next to it on a trivet, hard overhead window light from behind-left leaving a strong dark shadow on the wood

six opened oysters on a bed of coarse pink rock salt in a round steel platter on a whitewashed terrace table against a faded ochre wall, lemon wedges tucked between the shells, hard late-afternoon Provence sun from the left throwing each shell's sharp shadow across the salt, the platter filling the frame

shot from directly overhead: the half-dozen oysters fanned on pink salt on a sea-blue painted wooden table, two glasses of rosé at the edge of frame, a single hard beam of sun from the top right drawing crisp crescent shadows inside every shell

the oyster platter sits on the zinc bar counter of a small bistro against a deep-green tiled wall, a hand reaching in to lift one shell, hard window light from the right making the wet oyster flesh glisten and casting a clean shadow on the zinc

a single opened oyster resting on a small mound of pink rock salt on a terracotta saucer, close and large in frame, against a flat ochre-orange wall, hard low sun from the left catching the wet edge of the shell and dropping a long sharp shadow across the linen
fingers lift one oyster on its shell toward the lens over a sea-blue tablecloth on a sunny terrace, a lemon half beside the saucer, hard overhead midday sun leaving a tight dark shadow under the hand

a cast-iron escargot dish with six snails still bubbling in green garlic-herb butter on a worn oak bistro table against a deep bordeaux wall, a torn baguette beside it, hard side light from a window on the left making the butter shine and throwing the dish's shadow long across the wood

overhead on a terracotta-red tablecloth: the sizzling escargot plate, snail tongs and a small fork resting on the rim, a glass of white wine, hard sun from the top left giving every shell a crisp shadow

close low angle at the table: a piece of baguette dipped into the herb butter of one snail cup, steam rising, a mustard-yellow wall softly behind, hard back light from a window making the steam and butter glow

a shallow earthenware bowl of golden crisp roasted baby potatoes with a pool of brick-red roasted pepper and nut sauce on the side, on a sunlit terrace table against a whitewashed blue-shuttered wall, hard late sun from the right raking across the crisp skins and casting short sharp shadows
a hand dips one crisp potato into the red pepper sauce, the bowl large in frame on a mint-green tiled counter, hard window light from the upper left making the crackled skin sparkle

three golden crab and shrimp fritters stacked on a white plate with a small dish of pale green lime sauce, on a weathered blue wooden table by the sea, hard sun from the left throwing the stack's sharp shadow across the boards
one fritter broken open showing flaked crab and shrimp inside, held over the plate by a hand, a terracotta wall behind, hard side light catching the crisp golden crust and the rising steam

a generous Niçoise salad with green beans, olives, egg halves and leaves in a wide ceramic bowl, a slice of toasted tartine with goat cheese beside it, on a linen-covered terrace table against an ochre wall, hard late-afternoon sun from the right casting crisp shadows of the leaves and a glass of rosé
overhead on a sea-blue tablecloth: the salad bowl and the goat cheese tartine side by side, a fork lifting an olive, hard top-left sun drawing sharp little shadows under every ingredient

folds of smoked salmon with halved figs and pink grapefruit segments on a white plate, glossy vinaigrette, on a marble bistro table against a deep plum-colored wall, hard window light from the left making the salmon translucent and throwing clean shadows
close low angle on a sunlit terrace: the salmon and fig salad large in frame, a glass of white wine behind, hard back sun turning the grapefruit segments glowing pink

a deep bowl of saffron-orange bouillabaisse with fish, mussels and a lobster claw, toasted bread with rouille resting on the rim, on a worn oak table against a sea-blue wall, hard side light from a window on the left lighting the steam and casting the bowl's shadow long across the wood
a ladle pours the saffron broth over the seafood in the bowl, steam rising, a terracotta wall behind, hard back light making the steam and broth glow amber
overhead on a terracotta tablecloth: the bouillabaisse bowl, a basket of grilled bread and a small pot of rouille, hard sun from the top right giving each mussel shell a crisp shadow

a rustic bowl of green Provençal vegetable pistou soup with beans and pasta, a swirl of fresh basil pistou on top, a slice of bread spread with black tapenade beside it, on a linen table against an olive-green wall, hard window light from the right casting a clean shadow of the bowl
a spoon lifts vegetables from the pistou soup toward the lens on a sunlit terrace, the tapenade toast resting on the saucer, hard late sun from the left catching the steam

a thick sliced Wagyu ribeye fanned on a warm plate, pink centre showing, glossy porcini and brandy sauce poured over, on a dark walnut bistro table against a deep bordeaux wall, a glass of red wine, hard side light from the left making the sauce shine and the steak's shadow fall long
close low angle: the sauce being poured from a small copper pan over the sliced steak, the plate filling the frame, a mustard-yellow wall behind, hard back light catching the stream of sauce
overhead on a terracotta tablecloth: the ribeye plate, a steak knife resting on the rim and a hand holding the glass of red, hard top-left sun drawing crisp shadows

a dark red-wine braised beef cheek glistening on a bed of silky mashed potato in a shallow bowl, on a worn oak table against a deep ochre wall, hard window light from the left catching the glaze and casting a clean shadow of the bowl
a fork pulls apart the tender braised beef cheek, the bowl large in frame on a sea-blue tablecloth, hard side sun from the right making the wine sauce shine

a full rack of charred Iberian pork ribs on a wooden board with a small pot of golden pineapple-herb glaze, on a sunlit terrace table against a whitewashed wall, hard late-afternoon sun from the right raking across the charred crust and throwing the rack's long shadow
a hand brushes the pineapple glaze onto the ribs on the board, a terracotta wall behind, hard side light making the glaze drip and shine
overhead on a blue linen tablecloth: the rib board cut into pieces, a glass of rosé and grilled lemon halves, hard sun from the top left giving every rib a crisp shadow

a golden roasted dry-aged chicken leg with crisp skin, shaved black truffle and herbs on a white plate, on a dark oak bistro table against a deep green wall, hard window light from the left making the skin crackle and casting a clean shadow
a knife cuts into the chicken leg showing juicy meat, black truffle slices on top, the plate filling the frame, a mustard wall behind, hard back light catching the steam

a thick seared Atlantic salmon steak with crisp golden skin on a pale sauce with greens, on a white plate on a marble table against a sea-blue wall, hard side sun from the right glinting on the crisp skin and throwing a sharp shadow
overhead on a terracotta tablecloth: the salmon plate, a lemon half and a glass of white wine, hard top-left sun drawing crisp shadows of the fork and garnish

a glossy pan-seared black cod fillet with caramelised crust on a plate with a ruby-red fruit glaze, on a dark walnut table against a deep plum wall, hard window light from the left making the flakes shine and casting a clean shadow
a fork flakes the tender cod apart, the plate large in frame on a sunlit terrace table, hard late sun from the right catching the red glaze

a smooth lemon panna-cotta mousse on a small plate with lemon zest and a thin tuile, on a pale blue terrace table in strong Provence sun from the left, a crisp sharp shadow of the dessert and a coffee cup falling across the table
a spoon cuts into the wobbling lemon mousse, close and large in frame, an ochre wall behind, hard back light making the mousse glow

a slice of Earl Grey burnt Basque cheesecake with a deeply caramelised top and creamy centre on a stoneware plate, on an oak table against a terracotta wall, hard window light from the left catching the dark crust and casting a sharp shadow, a cup of tea beside it
a fork lifts a creamy bite from the cheesecake slice toward the lens, a sea-blue wall behind, hard side sun from the right making the burnt top glisten
